parameters.apprise_url_plus: clicksend://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.user_secret }} }:${ customer_secrets.{{ params.apikey_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.targets_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-clicksend-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your ClickSend account — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional ClickSend accounts bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"messages":[{"source":"php","to":"${ customer_secrets.CLICKSEND_SMS_TO }","body":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "") .. ((_body.title and _body.title ~= "" and _body.body and _body.body ~= "") and ": " or "") .. (_body.body or "")) *}}]}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment ClickSend destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your ClickSend number
parameters.summary: Send an SMS to your own ClickSend account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's ClickSend apikey

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's ClickSend targets

user_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's ClickSend user
